question.text:
Identify the inorganic sulphides that are yellow in colour :
(A) $\left(\mathrm{NH}_4\right)_2 \mathrm{~S}$
(B) $\mathrm{Pbs}$
(C) $\mathrm{Cus}$
(D) $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$
(E) $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_5$

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

solution.text: $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_3$ and $\mathrm{As}_2 \mathrm{~S}_5$ are yellow colour sulphides, $\left(\mathrm{NH}_4\right)_2 \mathrm{~S}$ is colourless, PbS is black, CuS is black in colour
